<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>EXHIBIT 3.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>FIDELITY 2022 CORE REAL ESTATE TRUST </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF TRUST </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THIS IS TO CERTIFY
THAT: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>FIRST</U></B>: The undersigned trustee does hereby form a statutory trust pursuant to the laws of the State of Maryland. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>SECOND</U></B>: The name of the statutory trust (the &#8220;Trust&#8221;) is: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:17%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Fidelity 2022 Core Real Estate Trust </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>THIRD</U></B>: The address of the Trust&#8217;s principal office in the State of Maryland is c/o The Corporation Trust Incorporated,
2405 York Road, Suite 201, Lutherville-Timonium, Maryland 21093-2264. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>FOURTH</U></B>: The name and business address of the
Trust&#8217;s resident agent are The Corporation Trust Incorporated, 2405 York Road, Suite 201, Lutherville-Timonium, Maryland 21093-2264. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The undersigned, being the sole trustee of the Trust, acknowledges under the penalties of perjury that, to the best of its knowledge and
belief, the facts stated herein are true. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[REMAINDER OF THIS PAGE INTENTIONALLY LEFT BLANK] </P>
